roles.name: Member 2 — Backend, database and deployment
roles.mission: Turn a private photo draft into one reviewed, published report through secure, predictable server routes.
roles.owns: app/api/*; lib/server/*; lib/contracts.ts; lib/supabase/browser.ts (public anonymous auth only); database/*; root configuration
roles.reviewer: Member 3 reviews image/model boundaries; Member 4 verifies deployed integration.

tasks.title: Create the shared development foundation
steps: Scaffold Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind; verify supported Node LTS and commit one lockfile.
Create Supabase/Vercel projects; deploy the starter; share repository and preview URL.
Create .env.example with names only; keep real .env.local ignored. Coordinate dependency changes through M2.
tasks.done: All four members can run the starter; the Vercel HTTPS preview opens on a phone; no real secrets are committed.
tasks.handoff: M1/M4 start UI work; give M3 server environment variable names.

tasks.title: Freeze request, response and ownership contracts
steps: Define report types, label rules and schemas in lib/contracts.ts; agree POST/PATCH/GET examples with all members.
Require a client_request_id UUID reused for retries; agree Bearer anonymous-session JWTs and stable error codes.
Record GEMINI_MODEL, VISION_MODE and server-only key names in .env.example; only the Supabase URL/public key may use NEXT_PUBLIC.
tasks.done: All owners accept sample JSON and field names; no frontend component needs a service-role or Gemini key.
tasks.handoff: M1 sends request IDs/tokens; M3 matches VisionResult; M4 consumes PublicReport.

tasks.title: Build the private database and photo store
steps: Add database/schema.sql for reports, UTC timestamps, status/source enums and UNIQUE(owner_id, client_request_id).
Create a private report-photos bucket with image MIME/size restrictions; enable anonymous sign-in.
Enable report/storage RLS denying direct browser access; server routes use the service key and explicit ownership checks.
tasks.done: Schema applies cleanly; an anonymous browser client cannot read or write rows/photos directly; the server can store one test image.
tasks.handoff: Share table fields and bucket name with M3; give M1 anonymous-session setup instructions.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated server route boundaries
steps: Create server-only helpers in lib/server; verify write tokens with getUser(token) and use the verified user ID.
Validate UUIDs, finite latitude/longitude ranges, note length ≤500 and allowed multipart fields; ignore client ownership/source/demo claims.
Return consistent JSON errors for missing authentication, invalid inputs, unavailable services and missing/foreign drafts.
tasks.done: Missing/invalid tokens fail; two anonymous sessions cannot access each other's draft; errors give M1 an actionable retry or correction state.
tasks.handoff: M1 wires error rendering; M4 records ownership test cases.

tasks.title: Create one recoverable private draft
steps: POST /api/reports in Node: decode JPEG/PNG/WebP with sharp; reject >8 MB or >40 megapixels. Reserve is_demo=true immediately in mock mode.
Reserve owner/request-ID row; store normalized ≤1600 px metadata-free photo, then image_path. M1 sends ≤3 MB.
Retries reuse/resume the same row; only INSERT winner invokes AI. Storage/DB errors remain retryable.
tasks.done: One private draft survives retries; publish stays blocked until image_path exists; failed storage never reports success.
tasks.handoff: M1 renders drafts; M3 gets bytes; M4 verifies.

tasks.title: Connect vision with a bounded fallback
steps: Call M3's server-only analyzeImage({bytes,mimeType}) within a 12-second application timeout; revalidate its result.
Save valid output as draft/vision; retain needs_review, unclear and manual_fallback on provider, schema or timeout failures.
Guard delayed updates against published rows. Preserve explicit mock source and demo status; never log keys, photo bytes or base64.
tasks.done: Live, timeout, invalid-output and mock cases return truthful drafts; late model results cannot overwrite publication.
tasks.handoff: M1 shows review/source states; M3 verifies provider failures with M2.

tasks.title: Publish the reviewed report in place
steps: PATCH /api/reports/{id}, action=publish: authenticate owner, require stored image, validate edited location/labels.
Enforce neutral exclusivity; generate complaints from reviewed labels, coordinates and UTC time, excluding private notes/contact information.
Update the same row; preserve first published_at on repeat confirmation. Preserve reserved is_demo=true; mock source also forces it.
tasks.done: Only owners publish; repeated confirmation creates no duplicate; reviewed fallback publishes; mock data cannot enter the real layer.
tasks.handoff: M1 unlocks Copy/Download; M4 refreshes the map with the returned published ID.

tasks.title: Expose a safe public map response
steps: Implement GET /api/reports with published-only selection and an explicit PublicReport field allowlist.
Exclude owner IDs, raw image_path fields and raw notes; add short-lived signed photo URLs and retain source/demo labels.
Bound query size; document ordering/retention; verify map refresh fetches fresh results after publication.
tasks.done: H12 live upload/review/publish/map/complaint works; public JSON excludes drafts; every route preserves real/sample distinctions.
tasks.handoff: M4 uses production-shaped data for polling, hotspots and image-expiry recovery.

tasks.title: Test the boundaries that can break the demo
steps: Check cross-owner reads/publishes, invalid coordinates, oversized/corrupt images, unsupported MIME and exclusive-label violations.
Retry the same request and confirmation; simulate model timeout and a delayed model response after publication.
Inspect public JSON, signed-link expiry and built client assets for private fields/secrets; document failures for immediate fixes.
tasks.done: M4 reproduces ownership/privacy/retry checks; failures have truthful UI responses; no service secret reaches the browser.
tasks.handoff: Send verified cases and remaining limitations to M4.

tasks.title: Prepare controlled sample data and deployment
steps: Create local-only database/seed.ts using server credentials; mark sample rows is_demo=true and keep photos licensed/consented.
Set Vercel environment values; verify Node runtime, model ID, storage and anonymous-auth configuration.
Confirm provider quota/host request limits; use a small controlled dataset and bounded image/model requests.
tasks.done: Sample hotspots appear only in sample view; clients cannot set is_demo; deployment completes one real submission.
tasks.handoff: M4 receives the exact seed/reset command and dataset scope; M3 verifies live quota.

tasks.title: Verify the deployed phone workflow
steps: Join M4's phone run over HTTPS: camera/file image, location correction, live analysis, review, publish and signed-photo display.
Recheck compressed upload size against Vercel limits; fix actionable errors for offline/retry and expired anonymous sessions.
Run repository build/type checks; confirm preview and final deployment use the intended VISION_MODE.
tasks.done: The final URL passes the core phone journey twice; quota/network fallback remains clearly labeled; build/type checks pass.
tasks.handoff: M4 freezes the demo URL; M1 receives final error/response behavior.

tasks.title: Freeze the backend and hand over recovery steps
steps: Merge reviewed changes; record deployed commit, environment names and setup/seed commands.
Give M4 recovery steps for quota failure, manual fallback and deliberate mock/sample mode; mode changes must preserve labels.
Check completed GitHub Issue tasks with evidence; leave optional hardening open.
tasks.done: M4 can recover the demo from written instructions; deployment/configuration are recorded; no core backend task remains unresolved.
tasks.handoff: M4 incorporates operations notes into docs/demo.md and the judging rehearsal.

roles.name: Member 3 — Vision integration and evaluation
roles.mission: Produce conservative visual suggestions with measurable limitations and an honest, reliable fallback.
roles.owns: lib/vision/*; evaluation/*; tests/vision/*; vision prompt, fixtures and evaluation evidence
roles.reviewer: Member 2 reviews server integration and secret handling; Member 1 reviews understandable labels.

tasks.title: Prove the chosen model works immediately
steps: In Google AI Studio, select a currently available Flash-family vision model; verify access instead of copying an old model ID.
Coordinate @google/genai installation with M2; run a server-side image request using an environment key.
Save the passing exact GEMINI_MODEL; record latency/quota errors without keys/images.
tasks.done: One real image returns successfully, or the team explicitly activates and documents manual/mock contingency.
tasks.handoff: M2 gets settings; M4 knows live availability.

tasks.title: Agree the vision boundary and display language
steps: Agree analyzeImage({bytes:Buffer,mimeType:string}): Promise<VisionResult> with M2 and import shared types from lib/contracts.ts.
Use only algal_bloom, oil_sheen, garbage, no_visible_pollution and unclear; neutral labels exclude all other labels.
Return labels, evidence ≤240 characters and review_needed. Tell M1 every result still requires human confirmation.
tasks.done: M1/M2 accept the sample payload and renderable fixture; types and label meanings agree before the review screen is built.
tasks.handoff: M1 uses plain-language label captions; M2 can build the adapter call before live integration.

tasks.title: Assemble an honest visual evaluation set
steps: Collect 20 consented/licensed images in evaluation/ with provenance; avoid faces, number plates and private metadata.
Assign four primary examples per label, including glare mistaken for oil, reflections/vegetation, blur and mixed visible pollution.
Record expected visible-label sets in evaluation/cases.csv; two teammates flag ambiguous examples without forcing certainty.
tasks.done: All 20 cases have provenance, expected labels and ambiguity notes; expectations describe visible appearance only.
tasks.handoff: M1/M4 receive a small clearly marked demo subset; preserve separate evaluation cases.

tasks.title: Write a conservative prompt and output schema
steps: Create lib/vision/prompt.ts: inspect visible water-surface cues; choose unclear when the photo cannot support a label.
Prohibit toxin, chemistry, drinking-safety and confidence-percentage claims; require brief evidence tied to visible features.
Define structured JSON and strict validation: nonempty allowed labels, uniqueness, neutral exclusivity, evidence length and boolean review_needed.
tasks.done: Valid single/multiple pollution labels pass; empty labels, mixed neutrals, invented enums and oversized evidence fail.
tasks.handoff: M2 imports the validator; M1 confirms the wording is understandable and editable.

tasks.title: Build the server-only live vision adapter
steps: Implement server-only lib/vision/analyze.ts using @google/genai, GEMINI_MODEL and normalized image bytes.
Request structured JSON and validate the returned data; throw typed errors for empty, invalid, blocked or failed responses.
Configure provider timeout/retries to fit M2's 12-second deadline; avoid uncontrolled automatic retries and log only safe diagnostics.
tasks.done: A sample produces valid VisionResult; malformed/provider-failed responses produce typed failures; logs contain no keys/images.
tasks.handoff: M2 imports the adapter for the draft route; coordinate dependency changes through M2.

tasks.title: Supply explicit mocks for the H6 thin slice
steps: Provide deterministic fixtures for successful labels, unclear, malformed output, timeout and provider error in tests/vision/fixtures.
Implement deliberate VISION_MODE=mock behavior; require server metadata analysis_source=mock and is_demo=true for publication.
Run the H6 upload/review contract check with M1/M2/M4; verify manual_fallback differs visibly from successful live vision.
tasks.done: The thin slice works without model access; all participants can identify live, manual fallback and mock results correctly.
tasks.handoff: M4 receives repeatable failure fixtures; M2 preserves source/demo metadata outside VisionResult.

tasks.title: Harden validation and failure handling
steps: Add meaningful tests for wrong types/enums, duplicate labels, neutral conflicts, overly long evidence, missing fields and provider failures.
Verify rejected output becomes needs_review/unclear/manual_fallback through M2's route instead of invented AI success.
Check a delayed provider response cannot overwrite a published row; confirm mock metadata survives review/publish.
tasks.done: Boundary tests pass and each invalid provider case produces a reviewable truthful fallback; delayed output cannot change a confirmed report.
tasks.handoff: M2 owns route/update fixes; M1 owns clear fallback explanations.

tasks.title: Complete the live H12 integration gate
steps: Run deployed uploads for garbage, surface-green water, sheen-like appearance and an unclear/clean image.
Confirm normalization preserves detail and model evidence stays brief and tied to visible features.
Review/edit labels before publish; verify source metadata, complaint wording and map behavior for neutral results.
tasks.done: A live image completes the journey; neutral/unclear results never become hotspots; failures remain usable through review.
tasks.handoff: M4 records H12 acceptance; M1/M2 fix any integration issue before presentation polish.

tasks.title: Measure model mistakes on the sample set
steps: Run 20 annotated images with the frozen model/prompt; save expected/predicted labels, latency and failure/source in evaluation/results.csv.
Count exact label-set matches, per-label misses and false positives; inspect clean/glare examples for overcalling.
Record invalid outputs and timeouts separately; do not count manual/mock results as successful AI predictions.
tasks.done: All 20 cases have results/false-positive notes; counts include denominators and describe this small sample only.
tasks.handoff: M4 gets honest judging evidence; M1 gets examples that need clearer review guidance.

tasks.title: Fix the clearest errors and verify the change
steps: Make one focused prompt revision for recurring glare/vegetation/ambiguity errors; preserve original results.
Rerun affected cases and five newly sourced unseen checks; record versions and changed outcomes separately.
Document persistent errors and strengthen review/unclear guidance; never present selected examples as broad accuracy.
tasks.done: Final prompt is versioned; regressions/limits are recorded; false positives have mitigation or documented limitations.
tasks.handoff: M2 deploys the final prompt; M4 uses only verified claims in the demo script.

tasks.title: Rehearse live and contingency demonstrations
steps: Check model access/quota; run a real phone photo on the final deployment with M4.
Rehearse unavailable-provider manual review and deliberate mock mode; mock output enters only the sample layer.
Prepare three sourced demo photos; explain why visual labels cannot establish water safety.
tasks.done: Live/contingency paths are rehearsed; the presenter names the active mode and explains limits without unsupported claims.
tasks.handoff: M4 gets photos, provenance, expected behavior and a short vision explanation.

tasks.title: Freeze vision and attach evidence to GitHub
steps: Merge reviewed changes; record exact model ID, prompt version, test command and limitations in evaluation/README.md.
Link schema-test output/evaluation counts in the assigned Issue; check completed items; leave optional improvements open.
Help M4 capture a backup identifying sample/manual/mock content; avoid late model/prompt changes.
tasks.done: Frozen model/prompt matches deployment; teammates can open evidence links; fallback never appears as live AI success.
tasks.handoff: M4 incorporates evaluation and contingency evidence into docs/demo.md and the judging presentation.
